why: The headline and infographic headline (EN 'in two tie-break sets', HI infographic 'दो टाई-ब्रेक सेट') are false. The score was 7-6(5), 7-5, so only the first set went to a tie-break; the story's own body says Alcaraz broke at 6-5 to take the second set 7-5. The main picture is also a tight, smiling red-carpet close-up (Laureus/IWC backdrop) with the top of his head cut off, not a tennis or trophy photo. The Ben Shelton in-story photo was 'NOT FOUND' although he is a top-5 player with free photos.
